Methodology: Lasso regression (α=0.9, 10-year window) maps 13 factor/style ETF ratios vs SPY to each FX rate. Residual = (actual − model) / actual × 100. Positive residual → currency overvalued relative to factor signals; negative → undervalued.
Factors: MTUM (Momentum), SPHB (High Beta), IWC (Micro Cap), IVW (LG Growth), IJT (SC Growth), IJR (Small Cap), IJS (SC Value), IJK (MC Growth), QUAL (Quality), IJJ (MC Value), VYM (High Div), IVE (LG Value), USMV (Min Vol).

AI Commentary · google/gemma-4-31B-it · 2026-06-16 22:31 UTC
Value and high-dividend factors proxy global risk appetite and carry-trade flows; their strength suggests a regime favoring high-yielding, cyclical assets like the BRL. A -10.1% residual indicates the BRL is fundamentally overvalued or the USD is undervalued relative to these equity drivers. Economically, this suggests idiosyncratic local strength or a market mispricing where the BRL is trading stronger than global risk-on equity factors justify.
